directions: Brown the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat until dark golden. Let the browned butter cool to room temperature.
In a bowl, mix flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
In a large bowl, combine cooled brown butter, sugar, vanilla extract, and sourdough starter until smooth.
Gradually fold in dry ingredients until just combined.
Gently mix in chocolate chips, dark chocolate chunks, graham crackers, and marshmallows.
Preheat oven to 375°F. Scoop dough onto parchment-lined cookie sheets.
Bake for 12–15 minutes or until golden around edges.
